preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the TetherToken (USDT) to exploit the accounting error
Contract must not be paused (paused = false)
Attacker must not be blacklisted (isBlackListed[attacker] = false)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability description mentions 'investing different collateral tokens in a single strategy contract could result in incorrect accounting'. While the provided code shows TetherToken (USDT) implementation, the actual exploit likely involves interacting with a separate Treasury contract that uses this token. The attack would involve depositing multiple token types into a strategy that doesn't properly segregate accounting, allowing cross-token balance manipulation. To exploit: 1) Deposit token A to strategy, 2) Deposit token B to same strategy, 3) Withdraw more of token A than deposited due to accounting confusion between token types.
